methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNRISD Publications is intended to expose the research output (working papers, occasional papers, flagship reports) of the UN Research Institute for Social Development. The configured URL https://www.unrisd.org/feed does NOT currently serve an RSS/Atom feed.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. This is the intended model, but cannot be exercised because no feed content is returned.

## Filters
Intended client-side only: publication date range and keyword. Category filtering would depend on per-item `<category>` tags, which cannot be confirmed as the feed is unavailable.

## Download
If a feed existed, the item link would point to a UNRISD publication landing page, which for research output often links a PDF. This could not be verified.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
The endpoint returns an HTML single-page-application shell (Content-Type text/html), not XML. The site is a Vue SPA: every probed path (/feed, /rss, /feed.xml, /rss.xml, /en/rss, /publications/feed, /feed/rss) returns HTTP 200 with the same JS app shell and no feed. No working RSS/Atom feed URL was found; this source is currently non-functional and requires a corrected feed URL or an alternate ingestion strategy (e.g. HTML scraping of the publications listing).
